title: Richard Socher's Recursive Superintelligence signs a $410M, multiyear AWS compute deal to support its self-improving AI systems, after raising $650M in May (Russell Brandom/TechCrunch)
summary: Russell Brandom / TechCrunch: Richard Socher's Recursive Superintelligence signs a $410M, multiyear AWS compute deal to support its self-improving AI systems, after raising $650M in May — On Tuesday, the AI company Recursive Superintelligence announced a $400 million compute deal with Amazon Web Services.
